description: This file defines functions for translating JIT schema argument types into structured C++ API types, particularly for the implementation of structured kernels in PyTorch. It handles type mapping, argument construction, and the preparation of parameters for different function variants.

methods.name: NamedCType argumenttype_type(t: Type, *, mutable: bool, binds: ArgName)
methods.description: Translates a JIT schema type into a C++ NamedCType suitable for structured kernel arguments.

methods.name: NamedCType argument_type(a: Argument, *, binds: ArgName)
methods.description: Wraps argumenttype_type for Argument objects, incorporating writeability.

methods.name: list[Binding] argument(a: Argument | SelfArgument | TensorOptionsArguments)
methods.description: Converts various argument objects into a list of Binding instances for structured kernel parameter definitions.

methods.name: list[Binding] impl_arguments(g: NativeFunctionsGroup)
methods.description: Generates a list of bindings for the implementation function, considering precomputed parameters.

methods.name: list[Binding] meta_arguments(g: NativeFunctionsGroup)
methods.description: Generates argument bindings for meta functions.

methods.name: list[Binding] out_arguments(g: NativeFunctionsGroup)
methods.description: Generates argument bindings for output parameters.

ctags.name: argumenttype_type
ctags.pattern: /^def argumenttype_type(t: Type, *, mutable: bool, binds: ArgName) -> NamedCType:$/
